opening.argument: The speaker frames the video as a walkthrough of selling a coin on an internal exchange. They use an example quantity of ten coins, show the displayed price, and press the button to place the order, which is then confirmed as saved. That sequence supports an operational demonstration: it shows how to submit a sale order. The speaker does not recruit viewers into an investment, promise extraordinary returns, request payment, or direct them through a deceptive claim process. The confirmation establishes only that the order was saved, not any financial outcome.

citations.quote: in this video I will show you how you can sell one coin on our internal exchange
For example, let's say I want to sell 10 van-coins.
And press the button to place the order. Your order has been saved successfully.
